findings.title: Team admin check uses AND with owner, and attendees can add guests
findings.body: `isTeamAdmin && isTeamOwner` requires both, so the check is wrong. Admins who are not owners are denied. Owners are usually also admins, so it mostly reduces to owner-only. Also, with teamId 0 fallback, queries run for non-team bookings. Use `||` for admin or owner, and skip the check when there is no teamId. Separately, any attendee (matched by email) can add guests, which may exceed the intended permissions.

findings.title: Guest dedupe and blacklist comparisons are case-sensitive
findings.body: The blacklist is lowercased but the guest email is not, so `Blocked@x.com` bypasses the blacklist. The comparison with existing attendees is also case-sensitive, so duplicates differing in case are added. Normalize guests with `.toLowerCase()` before comparing and storing. The client also does not check for duplicates against existing attendees.

findings.title: Organizer email is sent twice when team members exist
findings.body: The organizer gets an email without `teamMember`. Then each team member gets one too. If the organizer is also in `team.members`, they get duplicates. The existing location-change email handles this the same way, so check that code before copying it.

findings.title: Calendar update is unguarded and emails use unfiltered guests
findings.body: `updateCalendarAttendees` is not in a try/catch. If it throws, the attendees are already saved, the user sees an error, and no emails are sent. A retry then fails with 'emails_must_be_unique_valid'. Also `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` passes the raw input rather than `uniqueGuests`, so blacklisted guests get a scheduled email. The catch only logs a fixed string and drops the error.

findings.title: Error toast message never falls back
findings.body: The message is a template string, so it is always truthy. `unable_to_add_guests` is never shown, and the toast shows 'undefined: ...' when `err.data` is missing. Build the message conditionally.

held.title: Organizer lookup falls back to user id 0
held.body: If `booking.userId` is null, `findFirstOrThrow` with id 0 throws an unhelpful NotFound error after the permission check passes. Return a clear TRPC error instead.
